sources.edition: 5th edition; public author overview published in 2022
sources.scope: Public 2022 author overview of WHO fifth-edition myeloid classification. This is not the full current WHO Blue Book. The retrieved introduction, complete AML section (including its tables), and secondary-myeloid-neoplasm section define the available evidence scope. Do not apply this source to other tumour families or silently substitute ICC criteria.

sources.title: Diagnosis and management of AML in adults: 2022 recommendations from an international expert panel on behalf of the ELN
sources.scope: Optional ELN 2022 adult AML genetic risk assessment. This is a separate risk framework, not WHO disease classification. The article states that these risk categories were developed mainly from intensively treated patients; apply the retrieved qualifications, exclusions, and table footnotes. Do not present this as the latest guidance or infer treatment eligibility from the synthetic case.
